about: Fees of JLCPCB's PCB assembly and PCB prices for edakit cost (handbook 8.5). Every value carries the date it was read and its source. The assembly fees are those of JLCPCB's page 'PCB Assembly Cost: What Does the Price Include?' (last updated 2026-10-22, read 2026-10-27); JLCPCB converts to USD daily, so a value may differ by a cent from one week to the next. Bake, edge rails and the PCB prices are what JLCPCB charged in the carts of 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25 (2 layers, FR-4 TG135, 1.6 mm, 1 oz, lead-free HASL, green, 5 boards). Tiers: [from, to, price per unit]; the price of the tier the whole order falls in applies to every unit.

standard_setup.source: https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/pcb-assembly-price – Setup fee, Standard PCBA: $25.56 single side, $51.12 double side

standard_stencil.source: https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/pcb-assembly-price – Stencil, Standard PCBA: $8.21 single side, $16.42 double side

economic_loading.per: Extended part type (Basic and Preferred Extended free)

hand_soldering_labour.per: order with joints soldered by hand

reflow_joint.per: through-hole joint soldered in the reflow oven

standard_packing.per: order, plus per cm² of PCB area
standard_packing.source: https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/pcb-assembly-price – Packing: Economic free, Standard $0.50 + $0.00003 × PCB area (cm²)

large_size.per: order with a PCB area above 650 cm²

handling_min_difference.per: Standard order that Economic could also assemble: the shortfall below this difference

bake.per: order with a part of MSL 5 or more (and 2 days more)
bake.source: JLCPCB's request 'Bake Components' (7.94 $, 48 h) in the quote of 2026-10-24, Standard PCBA SMT026102460577, for XL-504SURD/UGD/UYD (C2895493, C2895549, C2895495), MSL 5 at JLCPCB

standard_edge_rails_mm.per: edge rail on each of the two long edges (the PCB is priced that much larger)
standard_edge_rails_mm.source: JLCPCB carts of 2026-10-24: a 100 × 100 mm and a 100 × 170 mm board under Standard PCBA were priced as 110 × 100 mm and 110 × 170 mm

pcb.spec: 2 layers, FR-4 TG135, 1.6 mm, 1 oz, lead-free HASL, green, tented vias, 5 boards, 24 h
